title.en: Stop the noisy GitHub-read wake for merged PRs
title.hant: 已合併 PR 的 GitHub 讀取失敗，不要再吵你

about.en: The contributions poll gives each gh call a hard 5 s bound; GitHub answers this repo in 0.9 to 4.4 s, so most polls fail and each failure wakes you. PR 142 merged on 2026-09-17 and its task is done.
about.hant: contributions poll 給每次 gh 呼叫 5 秒硬上限；GitHub 對這個 repo 要 0.9 到 4.4 秒回應，所以多數輪次失敗、每次失敗都叫你。PR 142 已在 9/17 合併，任務也結案。

if_nothing.en: About one wake every ten minutes keeps arriving; each costs a firstmate turn and none carries news.
if_nothing.hant: 大約每十分鐘再吵一次；每次都花 firstmate 一個回合，而且沒有任何新消息。

reversible_note.en: Both options change only the poll's bound and wake rule; the durable records stay intact.
reversible_note.hant: 兩個選項都只改 poll 的上限和喚醒規則，durable 紀錄不動。

label.en: Raise the per-call bound to 15 s
label.hant: 每次呼叫上限拉到 15 秒

consequence.en: Failures stop for this repo; a genuinely slow forge can now hold the poll up to 15 s per call inside the same 20 s budget.
consequence.hant: 這個 repo 不再失敗；真的慢的 forge 現在每次最多佔 15 秒，仍在 20 秒總預算內。

label.en: Keep the bound, stop waking on merged records
label.hant: 上限不動，已合併的紀錄失敗不叫人

consequence.en: No more noise for done work; an open PR on a slow repo would still fail and still wake you.
consequence.hant: 結案的工作不再吵；慢 repo 上還開著的 PR 仍會失敗、仍會叫你。

consequence.en: Removes the noise and the false failures; slightly larger diff, same test file.
consequence.hant: 噪音和假失敗都消失；diff 稍大，同一個測試檔。

recommend_why.en: The bound is wrong for GitHub's real latency, and a merged record has nothing to say; fixing only one leaves the other half of the symptom.
recommend_why.hant: 上限本來就不符合 GitHub 的真實延遲，而已合併的紀錄本來就沒話要說；只修一邊會留下另一半症狀。

detail.en: Demo card. On a real board this row appears only when the PR's checks are green and a merge is the captain's call.
detail.hant: 示範卡。真實看板上，這一列只在 PR 檢查全綠、且合併是船長決定時才出現。

if_nothing.en: The PR stays open; the current board stays English-only.
if_nothing.hant: PR 維持開著；現在的看板仍是純英文。

what.hant: 合併 PR 142：ParaSwap 換到 Velora API
